_meta.description: Elementalist subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: raw MAG, magic pen, DoT damage.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la MAG de 1% et les degats de sorts de 0.3% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases MAG by 1% and spell damage by 0.3% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la penetration magique de 0.8% et la chance de critique de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases magic penetration by 0.8% and crit chance by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les degats des effets sur la duree de 1.5% et la duree des debuffs de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases damage over time by 1.5% and debuff duration by 0.5% per level.
